difficulty_reason: With k, X and omega_X^bullet as in Lemma labelled lemma-duality-proper-over-field and t : H^0(X, omega_X^bullet) -> k as in Remark labelled remark-duality-proper-over-field, the lemma asserts that for a perfect complex E on X the pairings H^i(X, omega_X^bullet otimes^L E^vee) x H^{-i}(X, E) -> k given by xi, eta |-> t((1 otimes epsilon)(xi cup eta)) are perfect for every i (statement lines 7077-7095). The proof replaces E by E[-i] to reduce to the case i = 0, and then uses Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-ext-composition-is-cup to identify the displayed pairing with the one already discussed in Remark labelled remark-duality-proper-over-field, where its perfectness is proved (proof lines 7097-7103). Reducing to degree zero by a shift and matching the cup product pairing with the trace pairing of the remark is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
